invariants.rationale: The result of aggregate is produced by reducing potentially empty data with a zeroValue, so the output is expected to be non-null.
seqOp must be non-null to be used safely within the reduce operation.
combOp must be non-null to be used as the combiner in the reduce operation.
data must be non-null to invoke collectAsList.
zeroValue must be non-null as it is the initial value in the reduce operation.
